scope: Pinned registry sources. This declaration index does not claim every lexical pub item is reachable from a crate root, every macro expansion is indexed, every capability is implemented, or any test has passed.
method: All src/**/*.rs files scanned; Rust comments and string/character literals masked; lexical pub declarations/fields indexed with source lines and adjacent attributes. Root module/reexport list and capability matrix identify integration surfaces.
excluded_from_claims: Effective visibility inferred across private modules
